'''Vaibhav Global Limited''' ('''VGL''') is an Indian company that operates [[Home shopping|television shopping]] channels and [[e-commerce]] platforms, primarily focused on jewellery, gemstones, and lifestyle products. The company is headquartered in [[Jaipur]], [[Rajasthan]], and runs retail operations in multiple international markets.

== History ==
The company began as a gemstone exporter in 1980 and was incorporated as Vaibhav Enterprises in 1989. It was listed on Indian stock exchanges in 1996. In the mid-2000s, the company expanded into television retailing in the United States and United Kingdom. Following the 2008 financial crisis, VGL restructured its operations with an emphasis on lower-cost consumer products and developed online retail alongside its television channels.<ref name="BL2023">{{cite news |title=Vaibhav Global shifts focus to value retail |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/ |work=Business Line |date=2023 |access-date=15 September 2025}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite news|last1=Bang|first1=Nirmal|title=Vaibhav Global ready to shine: Nirmal Bang|url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/brokerage-recosfundamental/vaibhav-global-ready-to-shine-nirmal-bang_817344.html|access-date=19 October 2015|work=moneycontrol.com|date=5 February 2013|ref=2}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite news|title = Indian company Vaibhav Global dresses up middle-class Americans|url = http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/the-indian-company-that-caters-to-middle-class-americans-115062400756_1.html|access-date = 2015-10-19|newspaper = Business Standard India|date = 24 June 2015}}</ref>

== Operations ==
VGL operates television shopping channels and e-commerce websites in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Austria. Its main platforms include [[Shop LC]] (US), [[TJC (TV channel)|TJC]] (UK), [[Ideal World]] (UK and Ireland), and Shop LC DE (Germany).<ref name=":0">{{cite news|last1=Mudar|first1=Patherya|title=Vaibhav Global: India's successful e-tail model|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/vaibhav-global-india-s-successful-e-tail-model-115062100962_1.html|access-date=19 October 2015|work=Business Standard|date=21 June 2015|ref=1}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-09-25 |title=Vaibhav Global acquires Ideal World assets |url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2023/09/25/vaibhav-global-acquires-ideal-world-assets/ |access-date=2023-09-25 |website=Broadband TV News |language=en-GB}}</ref> In 2023, the company acquired the Mindful Souls platform, which offers lifestyle and wellness products.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Arushi |title=Vaibhav Global's subsidiary to acquire 'Mindful Souls' in €12 million deal |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/vaibhav-globals-subsidiary-to-acquire-mindful-souls-in-12-million-deal/article67351797.ece |access-date=16 September 2025 |work=BusinessLine |date=27 September 2023 |language=en}}</ref>
